{{Quote|Get it done, or I'll do it for you &mdash; my way.|Iola Linst|<ref name="GG2-1" />}}
'''Iola Linst''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was [[Chief Executive Officer/Legends|Chief Executive Officer]] of [[Damarind Fishing Station]] in the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]].

==Biography==
Iola Linst was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]]. Her [[Iona Linst's father|father]] was a jewel [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] from an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]<ref name="GG2-1" /> [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]]<ref name="GG2-2">[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin'', Second Edition]]</ref> who was also one of the founding fathers of [[Damarind Corporation]].<ref name="GG2-1" /> She attended the best educational institutions, and excelled at the middle-management positions that her father secured for her in the jewellery trade. However, Linst fell in love with a man her father disapproved of, and declared her intention to [[Marriage/Legends|marry]] him. Around [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], her father subsequently transferred her to be the [[Chief Executive Officer]] of the [[Damarind Fishing Station]] in the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]].<ref name="GG2-2" />

Although upset at the posting, Linst was determined not to show it. She was sure that he father had [[Spy/Legends|spies]] at the station watching her.<ref name="GG2-2" /> Aware of nepotism involved in her position,<ref name="GG2-1" /> she knew that many of the employees on the station resented her position and believed that her posting was based on connections rather than ability. She was in her mid-thirties by [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="GG2-2" />

==Personality and traits==
Iola Linst was of medium height, standing 1.62 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall with light skin and [[Color/Legends|brown]] hair which she styled in a Core Worlds fashion. She had a severe-looking face<ref name="GG2-1" /> set in a near-constant frown with worry lines around her eyes and mouth. Bright and talented, Linst had a flair for business. After her posting to Damarind Fishing Station,<ref name="GG2-2" /> she tried to prove her ability in role as CEO of Damarind Fishing Station,<ref name="GG2-1" /> and determined to do the job to the best of her ability. Her removal from the Core led to her being very lonely, which Linst masked with ruthless efficiency<ref name="GG2-2" /> leading her to be the most efficient executive within Damarind.<ref name="GG2-1" /> When faced with delays and excuses, she was impatient.<ref name="GG2-2" />

==Skills and abilities==
Iola Linst was knowledgeable about [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucratic]] procedure and business practices, especially pertaining to the jewellery business. She was skilled in other languages, and could bargain and con as needed during negotiations. Linst had a commanding and intimidating presence, was a [[Gambler/Legends|gambler]], and could bypass security systems.<ref name="GG2-2" />

==Equipment==
Linst wore a Damarind Company uniform, and carried a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]], [[Chronometer/Legends|chronometer]], and [[pocket computer]]. She armed herself with a [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]].<ref name="GG2-2" />
